description: Compute the maturity value of a certificate of deposit given a principal, a nominal annual interest rate (as a percent), a term in months, and a compounding frequency (periods per year, e.g. 1 = annually, 12 = monthly). Also reports the effective annual yield (APY) implied by the nominal rate and compounding frequency, and, when an early-withdrawal penalty in months of forfeited interest is given, the net payout if withdrawn before maturity.

annualRatePercent.description: Nominal annual interest rate, as a percent, e.g. 5

compoundsPerYear.description: Compounding periods per year, e.g. 1 = annually, 4 = quarterly, 12 = monthly, 365 = daily

earlyWithdrawalPenaltyMonths.description: Optional early-withdrawal penalty, in months of forfeited interest; when given, also computes the net early-withdrawal payout

principal.description: The deposit principal (must be greater than zero)

name: calculate_cd_maturity
